description:
Report unexpected tool errors, missing capabilities, confusing output, or unclear docs.

        Only message is required. Describe your goal, what you tried, what you expected,
        and any workaround. Feedback is saved for the maintainers to review.

examples.message: Search returned an unclear continuation error; restarting worked.

category.description: Optional triage category; defaults to other.
category.title: Category

message.description: Required feedback: your goal, what you tried, expected behavior, and what happened. Include any workaround. Must contain 1–2000 characters.
message.title: Message

severity.description: Optional severity: high means blocked, medium means a workaround was found, and low means a minor annoyance. Defaults to medium.
severity.title: Severity

toolName.description: Optional name of the tool this feedback concerns.
toolName.title: Toolname

name: give_feedback
title: Give product feedback
